changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment: Backfills the overdue-installment charge snapshot using the product's current charge. Historical charge amounts and calculation types are not recoverable, so pre-existing loans are pinned to today's values rather than to the values at their creation date. All loan statuses are backfilled: a loan that is not yet active today may still be approved or disbursed later, and one that is closed today may be reopened, so an unpopulated snapshot would otherwise silently fall back to the live charge. When a product has more than one overdue-installment charge, the one with the lowest id is picked, consistent with LoanProduct#getOverdueInstallmentCharge().
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan SET overdue_charge_id = ( SELECT mc.id FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id -- charge_time_enum = 9 is ChargeTimeType.OVERDUE_INSTALLMENT, charge_applies_to_enum = 1 is loan charges WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1 ORDER BY mc.id LIMIT 1), overdue_charge_amount = ( SELECT mc.amount FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1 ORDER BY mc.id LIMIT 1), overdue_charge_calculation_type = ( SELECT mc.charge_calculation_enum FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1 ORDER BY mc.id LIMIT 1) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_product_loan_charge plc JOIN m_charge mc ON mc.id = plc.charge_id WHERE plc.product_loan_id = m_loan.product_id AND mc.charge_time_enum = 9 AND mc.charge_applies_to_enum = 1)
